title: Mining and genomic characterization of resistance to tan spot, Stagonospora nodorum blotch (SNB), and Fusarium head blight in Watkins core collection of wheat landraces
full_text_facts: The study phenotyped 119 Watkins landraces for FHB and identified five moderately resistant accessions.
The stated GWAS objective and the marker-trait association section cover tan spot races 1/5 and SNB, not FHB.
Main Table 2 and supplementary candidate-region tables contain tan-spot/SNB loci only.
reason: No FHB QTL, SNP association, linkage interval or candidate-gene locus is reported; title/abstract-level inclusion would misattribute leaf-spot GWAS loci to FHB.
retained_value: FHB-resistant germplasm/material evidence: Watkins accessions 1190032, 1190308, 1190551, 1190662 and 1190788 were moderately resistant in field and greenhouse follow-up.
